strings.read:
{0c:f706c1}{0c:510828001000}{0b:08}【 誰かを待っている男 】{0b:09}
何しに来た?
今は入っても無駄だぜ。{1a}{0c:2800231000}バルデスに門を開けてもらわなきゃ
『時の回廊』より先に
進むことは出来ねえよ。{1a}俺か? 俺はここで
バルデスが来るのを待ってるのさ。
酒場には行きたくねえんでな。{1a}ああ、そうさ、
クムランの野郎のツラを
見たくねえからだよ。{1a}許せるか?
奴のやろうとしていることは
6年もツルんできた相棒に

strings.en:
{0c:f706c1}{0c:510828001000}{0b:08}【 Man Waiting for Someone 】{0b:09}
What're you here for? Ain't no use goin'
in now.{1a}{0c:2800231000}Unless Valdes opens the gate for you,
there's no gettin' past the 'Corridor
of Time'.{1a}Me? I'm waitin' here for Valdes to come. I
don't feel like goin' to the tavern.{1a}Yeah, that's right, 'cause I don't wanna
see that bastard Qumran's face.{1a}How can anyone forgive it? What he's
tryin' to do is the same as tellin' the
partner he's run with for six years to
go die.{1a}{0c:5110}Because of that bastard, Valdes...
Dammit... What a lousy night...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: What're you here for? Ain't no use goin' in now. // [1]Unless Valdes opens the gate for you, there's no gettin' past the 'Corridor of Time'. // Me? I'm waitin' here for Valdes to come. I don't feel like goin' to the tavern. // Yeah, that's right, 'cause I don't wanna see that bastard Qumran's face. // How can anyone forgive it? What he's tryin' to do is the same as tellin' the partner he's run with for six years to go die. // [2]Because of that bastard, Valdes... Dammit... What a lousy night...

strings.jp:
{0c:510828001000}今は入っても
無駄だって言ったはずだぜ。
早く帰って寝な。{1a}認めたくねえが、
お前達の方が俺達より
『始原の地』に近いのは事実なんだ。
ほら、さっさと消えろ。{0c:fe}

strings.en:
{0c:510828001000}I told ya, there ain't no use goin' in now.
Go home and get some sleep.{1a}I hate to admit it, but you lot are closer
to the 'Land of Origin' than we are. Go
on, get lost.{0c:fe}
